approver: repository owner (in-session: "lets go with D2 and D3 ... opencode deepseek v4.1 flash or longcat", "we can use more tokens, i am more worry of cutoff, invalid structures")
purpose: Freeze the owner-matched generation/judge request tuple required by D17 before any live comparison run. Recording the tuple is not permission to run it.

generator.source_of_selection: decisions.md, 2026-10-20 matched baseline tuple; reaffirmed 2026-10-21 (D17 profile choice and generator accepted)

judge.family_independence_argument: The matched generator is deepseek-v4.1-flash (DeepSeek family); the judge is LongCat (Meituan family). The candidate deepseek-v4.1-flash judge was rejected because it is the generator itself.
judge.token_limit_rationale: Owner 2026-10-24: generous output budget preferred over cutoff risk; truncated judge output is the dominant invalid-structure failure mode. Applied as a run-scoped overlay (APP__LLM__JUDGE_MAX_TOKENS=16384); the committed default of 1024 is unchanged.
judge.prompt_source: src.evals.metrics.medical.METRIC_SPECS (DeepEval metric prompts, sent verbatim as a single raw user message)

retrieval.note: Carried unchanged from the 2026-10-19 baseline configuration snapshot; the reranker asset is still unselected and undownloaded.

review_binding.scope: content-consistency attestations only; no reviewer-identity, qualification, or clinical-endorsement claim

budget.spend_to_date_basis: about 0.0155 Go quota-value reserved (Stage A smoke, zero cash) plus about 0.006 estimated embedding cost (D11 materialization)
budget.judge_cost_class_estimate: at 16,384 output tokens the worst-case judge call is about $0.02; realistic verdict-plus-reasoning usage is far below the cap, and a 100-case x 6-metric pass is estimated in the low single-digit dollars

source.scope: configuration tuple and identity pointers only; not an atomic tree snapshot and not a runtime semantic identity

limitations: The judge shares the generator's route (OpenCode Go). Model-family independence is satisfied; route independence is not, and the shared-route confound must be reported with any comparison.
OpenCode Go acceptance of the judge's max_completion_tokens wire field is unverified; pydantic-ai sends it for models without a known profile.
Judge availability, latency, usage reporting, and quality are asserted only from the public model catalog, not from a live call.

The generator's structured-output capability through this route is unestablished: Stage A's live smoke ended at the baseline structured-output rejection with the adapter's structured modes unreached. Adapter generation remains opt-in and preflight stays fail-closed.
The D11 corpus binding is reproducible only where data/chroma-d11 exists; the committed export script plus the recorded digests are the reproduction path.
No live baseline exists for this tuple: live_baseline_captured and provider_outputs_captured are false, and no cutover or default-promotion inference follows from this snapshot.
